about: Package 4 (prompt card and lyric sheet): every scenario this package makes runnable, each with what it exercises. 33-fields.mjs holds on the concept page too (--page hotstep-tiers.html): several of its scenarios are the concept's own with the one step they share with a later package (the popover's presets) replaced by one of this package's, or with an option found by its value as well as its words (deviation 10). `waiting` entries exercise this package's work and wait on another's part; `excluded` lists the concept's scenarios about the prompt or the lyrics that are left out, each with the reason.

scenarios.why: Each text field's own Ctrl+Z (F-22): the field's own texts first, then on into what the page put there (Expand), Redo the same way, a value set without telling is a step of its own, Ctrl+Z in another field never touches the box.
F-06: Ctrl+Z in the box takes back its last typing and moves the page's step that wrote it, so Ctrl+Z outside goes on back to the setting, never the words again.
Typing in the sheet is one step named for the lyrics; the sheet drawn again at Quick keeps its own history; once back at empty, Ctrl+Z goes on to the page and never puts the words back.

lyricSheet: the Lab tabs insert at a line boundary, the strip and a segment's caret, Instrumental read-only and the tabs refused, Expand with Undo and with none, Expand on Generate, the vocal gender, an engine with no lyrics (05-modules/lyrics).
The sheet grows a ruled line at a time, stops at its cap and scrolls with a marker on the margin and a fade at the end there is more (A-28, Q-28).
The language stamp: choosing a language leaves it where it was (L-02, E-01), and at Quick it shows while it is not the default (Q-07).

promptBox: wildcards, Expand on Generate and what Generate will do, Expand keeping focus in the box, Write it for me, its question and Replace lyrics (F-17, C-29), its toast's Undo, Song info opening with focus and closing marked.

Compose caption (empty, with BPM and key, not twice), the caption source's chips, Automatic locking the box, the locked box pointing at Edit a copy and saying why (E-31), Edit a copy and its Undo (E-06), the dataset tags on YuE2 (06-prompt-generate/minimax-caption).
Quick shows the ask and the lyric card; Studio puts the lyrics on the desk as a tile.
Ctrl+Z inside a text field is the field's while it has typing to take back, then the page's (L-05, E-18).
Lyrics and a BPM in the box are noticed; Move to lyrics and its Undo; Set the tempo field brings Tempo with that BPM; the placeholder turns while the box is empty.
Instrumental: the line count says nothing more, the tabs, Expand and the stamp stand back and say so (L-22, Q-27).
Ctrl+Z in a number box with nothing typed goes to the page's Undo, and again (L-05).
The stamp says what the language does on MiniMax-Music3; Compose caption writes it into Vocal Details (E-14, E-21).
At Quick with the source on Custom there is no From chip (E-22).
The From chip; a dataset that lacks the chosen track puts the source on Custom in the same step and says so (E-08, E-22); back on the first nothing re-locks.
YuE2 offers to set the tempo field from the box, as ACE-Step does (E-38).
One word for the main box per engine (S-05): the box is named Tags, Write it for me writes tags and says so, the Quick Sampler row follows the tags.
Tab from the box visits the tiles in reading order, the lyric sheet at the desk's head (Q-01).
Same at Quick, the sheet under the box.
Same at Lab, 1280 wide.
Pending (F-13) in the concept, right here: Move them to the lyrics sheet puts focus in the lyrics it filled.
Pending (S-07) in the concept, right here: the line count's estimate takes a BPM written in HeartMuLa's tags (src/derive/controls.ts songTempo, src/derive/fields.ts estimateTempo).
Wildcards, Expand, Write it for me and Song info (all pass), and Presets & genres.

waiting.because: Presets & genres open in the popover (#pop), which package 8 builds; the prompt card runs its named action stylePresets, which then has its content to show.

scenarios.why: Each field's own Ctrl+Z with the page's Undo (F-22); the same in 33-fields/field-undo-and-page-undo.

waiting.because: Its page step is a style preset chosen in the popover (#pop), which package 8 builds.

scenarios.why: The line count's estimate on auto says it guesses (passes), and takes a BPM typed on YuE2.

waiting.because: The BPM is typed into Tempo's LCD row (lcdRow holding lcdNumber), which package 2 draws.

scenarios.why: Pending (E-06) in the concept: Automatic follows the BPM at once; the lock line follows the tempo field in the core (src/derive/fields.ts trackNow).

waiting.because: Its BPM is typed into Tempo's LCD row (lcdRow holding lcdNumber), which package 2 draws.

scenarios.why: Pending (S-06) in the concept: the ruler's note follows a BPM typed in the box (passes) and a BPM chip.

waiting.because: Its first change is a BPM chip on the Length tile (capChips), which package 3 draws.

scenarios.why: Ctrl+Z under the Concept notes, the picker or another page leaves the box as it is (F-04).

waiting.because: The Concept notes and the picker are package 8's layers; the page's Undo holds off while a layer it does not know of yet is open.

excluded.why: Its vocal gender is found by data-v="Duet", the option's label (deviation 10: the rebuild's data-v is the value). Every check of it is in 33-fields/lyrics-tags-strip-instrumental-wildcards.
Its Automatic is found by data-opt="Automatic" (deviation 10). Every check of it is in 33-fields/minimax-caption-and-the-caption-source.
Its French is found by data-opt="French" (deviation 10). Its check is in 33-fields/language-stamp-stays-put.

It reads the concept's storage key hs3-lang-recent (deviation 17). The stamp's list is in 32-controls-gallery/chip-model-and-stamp-pickers, the stamp on the sheet in 33-fields/language-stamp-stays-put.

Its setting is Takes' while Takes is not on the desk, which the rebuild does not hold in force (the slice's rule of the value in force). The same checks with Takes on the desk: 33-fields/field-undo-never-moves-forward.

Write it for me, the typing after it and Undo from its toast all pass; its last check wants the Undo toast to say what was left ("The description changed since, so it was left as it is"), which the store's Undo (store/desk.ts, the slice's) does not say yet. Flagged for the coordinator.
Its wildcard line and Expand on Generate pass; the rest checks the song Generate makes (package 6).
It opens a factory workflow (findPreset, package 7); the one-line empty card on a short window is the concept's CSS, which applies to the same markup.
Its box checks pass (Write it for me says a prompt, the box is named Prompt); the rest are the engine panel's words (package 5), the Length tile's (package 3) and Drafts (package 7).
Its subject is the Length tile's prompt chips (capChips, package 3).
Its subject is Tempo at Quick (package 3); the Compose caption it runs is this package's named action composeCaption, ready for the tile's button.
The prompt chips and the ranges are package 3's.
It needs the whole desk (Repaint, workflows, seeds, the source song) of later packages; the box's text and the latent are in the desk record here.
